scope: Read-only review of four relevant registered versions, fixed official source bytes, production protection and existing targeted tests. Not a 29-Agent sweep or new acceptance run.
decision: No reproducible product defect established. Keep the common implementation and the specific unverified conditions.

agents.control: Official declared /compact; self-managed context providers may reject it.
agents.sourceLifecycle: Manual command returns ordinary text; no compaction_update/compaction_summary_chunk producer was found in the inspected ACP implementation. Optional status and usage do not supply reliable per-compaction identity and terminal.
agents.commonHandling: Ordinary prompt admission and original response rendering apply. Never infer a typed terminal from reply wording, usage decrease or prompt end.
agents.actualScope: Installed 091fac1 command and same-conversation recall succeeded: three sends, no tools/cancel, Ultra free/off. Current stored structure matches the official behavior; no pre-compaction physical snapshot or captured typed lifecycle. Content-free tap cannot establish runtime typed-event absence.
agents.remaining: Typed start/terminal and separately continuing activity lack a producer on this inspected route. Full failure/cancel, context-result and preservation conditions remain open. Repeating this text-only sample would not resolve the interface gap.

agents.control: Official declared /compact with optional instructions; empty history returns text without starting compaction.
agents.sourceLifecycle: Nonempty manual command generates one UUID, emits tool_call in_progress, awaits app_server.compact, then emits tool_call_update completed. AppServerResponseError emits failed and propagates the error. These are typed tool events, not compaction_update.
agents.commonHandling: Existing generic tool_activity and tool rendering protect the identified activity. No English-title matching or Agent-specific UI is needed.
agents.actualScope: Installed 65a25cc saw one associated tool card progress then result/end, and an unsent probe offered queuing: two narrow positives, one incomplete busy-configuration observation. No raw tool identity/status or SDK terminal was captured. Later separate busy-configuration evidence does not rewrite this original incomplete case.
agents.remaining: Exact current wire lifecycle, failure/cancel, retained draft/queue, shared maintenance and post-request activity remain separate. Selected executable/source equivalence is unproven. Source does not upgrade UI records into protocol proof.
agents.requestRestriction: The specifically authorized single Mistral request has been consumed; no further compact/model request this round.

agents.control: Official adapter runCompact uses thread/compact/start and correlates thread/turn/item events.
agents.sourceLifecycle: With client session.compaction capability, contextCompaction item start/completion produces compaction_update. Legacy thread/compacted completion-only handling is deduplicated. Failure/cancellation closes unfinished activity explicitly.
agents.commonHandling: Farfold declares the official capability and consumes the raw typed patches through its common tracker, display and protection.
agents.remaining: No new exact selected account/model official lifecycle sample. Source support is not installed end-to-end acceptance.

agents.control: Official adapter consumes SDK compacting/compact_result/compact_boundary, with typed mode for clients declaring compaction.
agents.sourceLifecycle: Compacting starts activity; successful result/boundary completes, failure reports failed, unfinished cancellation remains explicit. PostCompact summary is distinct from full history. Synthetic tool fallback is for clients without typed capability.
agents.commonHandling: Existing common typed compaction handling can consume these events; no branded component or inferred terminal.
agents.remaining: Current usable account, selected model and exact official lifecycle sample are not established.
agents.requestRestriction: Do not assume a usable account/model from registration metadata.

checks: Current production compaction/tool activity protection reviewed; no new grounded defect or new model test. Existing shared tests also ran in the batch seven checks; that remains controlled evidence.
